summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub source
details: package.json declares `"libsignal": "github:tenka-san/libsignal-node"` as a dependency, resolving to the default branch of that GitHub repository rather than a registry version range or a pinned commit SHA. On `npm install`, the resolver fetches whatever bytes currently exist on that branch and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in them, with no version lock and no integrity check. Whoever controls the tenka-san/libsignal-node repository can therefore deliver arbitrary code into every installer's environment at install time by pushing to the branch, and the delivered code can change silently between installs of the same @poucode/baileys version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
